design: Reuse goal save/idempotency and existing tombstone schema. Edit pins opening owner and stable command. Goal deletion atomically tombstones linked reminders through their repository before parent tombstone; existing reminder reconciliation owns native cancellation. Editing a goal retains independently selected reminder time; no implicit opt-in or reschedule.
compatibility: No schema migration; existing isDeleted/localRevision/outbox fields
Delete operationKind emitted for sync, rollout remains off
Deleted goals cannot be resurrected by stale save
